queries.label: read_only
queries.sql: SELECT readonly FROM duckdb_databases() WHERE database_name='telchi'

queries.label: customer_identity
queries.sql: SELECT code,name,status,sap_valid_for,sap_frozen_for,credit_limit,payment_term_id FROM read_parquet('/media/issajar/DEVELOP/Projects/iMotorSoft/ai/lab/dataclient/telchi/reference/_versions/v2_reference_closure_2088d5885204313a/customers/part-00000.parquet') WHERE source_system='SAP_HANA' AND code=?

queries.label: duplicate_invoice_headers
queries.sql: SELECT source_system,doc_entry,count(*) n FROM (SELECT * FROM telchi.atomic."sales_document" AT (VERSION => 1408)) GROUP BY ALL HAVING count(*)>1

queries.label: duplicate_credit_headers
queries.sql: SELECT source_system,doc_entry,count(*) n FROM (SELECT * FROM telchi.atomic."credit_memo_document" AT (VERSION => 1408)) GROUP BY ALL HAVING count(*)>1

queries.label: duplicate_invoice_lines
queries.sql: SELECT source_system,doc_entry,line_num,count(*) n FROM (SELECT * FROM telchi.atomic."sales_line" AT (VERSION => 1408)) WHERE source_system='SAP_B1_HANA' GROUP BY ALL HAVING count(*)>1

queries.label: duplicate_catalog
queries.sql: SELECT item_code,count(*) n FROM read_parquet('/media/issajar/DEVELOP/Projects/iMotorSoft/ai/lab/dataclient/telchi/reference/_versions/v2_reference_closure_2088d5885204313a/products/part-00000.parquet') WHERE source_system='SAP_HANA' GROUP BY ALL HAVING count(*)>1

queries.label: duplicate_business_types
queries.sql: SELECT b.canonical_product_id,count(*) n FROM read_parquet('/media/issajar/DEVELOP/Projects/iMotorSoft/ai/lab/dataclient/telchi/crosswalk/_versions/v2_reference_closure_2088d5885204313a/product_business_type/part-00000.parquet') b JOIN read_parquet('/media/issajar/DEVELOP/Projects/iMotorSoft/ai/lab/dataclient/telchi/reference/_versions/v2_reference_closure_2088d5885204313a/products/part-00000.parquet') p USING(canonical_product_id) WHERE p.source_system='SAP_HANA' GROUP BY ALL HAVING count(*)>1

queries.label: orphan_invoice_lines
queries.sql: SELECT count(*) n FROM (SELECT * FROM telchi.atomic."sales_line" AT (VERSION => 1408)) l LEFT JOIN (SELECT * FROM telchi.atomic."sales_document" AT (VERSION => 1408)) d ON d.source_system=l.source_system AND d.doc_entry=l.doc_entry WHERE l.source_system='SAP_B1_HANA' AND d.doc_entry IS NULL

queries.label: document_universe
queries.sql: SELECT 'OINV' kind,canceled,currency,min(doc_date) first_date,max(doc_date) last_date,count(*) documents FROM (SELECT * FROM telchi.atomic."sales_document" AT (VERSION => 1408)) WHERE source_system='SAP_B1_HANA' AND doc_date>='2026-01-01' AND doc_date<'2026-09-25' GROUP BY ALL UNION ALL SELECT 'ORIN',canceled,currency,min(doc_date),max(doc_date),count(*) FROM (SELECT * FROM telchi.atomic."credit_memo_document" AT (VERSION => 1408)) WHERE source_system='SAP_B1_HANA' AND doc_date>='2026-01-01' AND doc_date<'2026-09-25' GROUP BY ALL

queries.label: observed_full_coverage
queries.sql: SELECT 'OINV' kind,min(doc_date) first_date,max(doc_date) last_date FROM (SELECT * FROM telchi.atomic."sales_document" AT (VERSION => 1408)) WHERE source_system='SAP_B1_HANA' AND canceled='N' UNION ALL SELECT 'ORIN',min(doc_date),max(doc_date) FROM (SELECT * FROM telchi.atomic."credit_memo_document" AT (VERSION => 1408)) WHERE source_system='SAP_B1_HANA' AND canceled='N'

queries.label: portfolio_evidence
queries.sql: SELECT f.code,r.status,r.source,count(*) products FROM read_parquet('/media/issajar/DEVELOP/Projects/iMotorSoft/ai/lab/dataclient/telchi/reference/_versions/v2_reference_closure_2088d5885204313a/products/part-00000.parquet') p JOIN read_parquet('/media/issajar/DEVELOP/Projects/iMotorSoft/ai/lab/dataclient/telchi/crosswalk/_versions/v2_reference_closure_2088d5885204313a/product_portfolio_family/part-00000.parquet') r USING(canonical_product_id) JOIN read_parquet('/media/issajar/DEVELOP/Projects/iMotorSoft/ai/lab/dataclient/telchi/reference/_versions/v2_reference_closure_2088d5885204313a/portfolio_family/part-00000.parquet') f USING(portfolio_family_id) WHERE p.source_system='SAP_HANA' GROUP BY ALL

queries.label: business_classification_evidence
queries.sql: SELECT b.product_business_type,b.status,b.classification_basis,count(*) products FROM read_parquet('/media/issajar/DEVELOP/Projects/iMotorSoft/ai/lab/dataclient/telchi/reference/_versions/v2_reference_closure_2088d5885204313a/products/part-00000.parquet') p JOIN read_parquet('/media/issajar/DEVELOP/Projects/iMotorSoft/ai/lab/dataclient/telchi/crosswalk/_versions/v2_reference_closure_2088d5885204313a/product_business_type/part-00000.parquet') b USING(canonical_product_id) WHERE p.source_system='SAP_HANA' GROUP BY ALL

queries.label: customer_amounts
queries.sql: SELECT 'OINV' kind,currency,count(*) documents,count(doc_total) amount_count,sum(cast(doc_total AS DECIMAL(38,6))) amount,min(doc_date) first_date,max(doc_date) last_date FROM (SELECT * FROM telchi.atomic."sales_document" AT (VERSION => 1408)) WHERE source_system='SAP_B1_HANA' AND canceled='N' AND doc_date>='2026-01-01' AND doc_date<'2026-09-25' AND card_code=? GROUP BY ALL UNION ALL SELECT 'ORIN',currency,count(*),count(doc_total),sum(cast(doc_total AS DECIMAL(38,6))),min(doc_date),max(doc_date) FROM (SELECT * FROM telchi.atomic."credit_memo_document" AT (VERSION => 1408)) WHERE source_system='SAP_B1_HANA' AND canceled='N' AND doc_date>='2026-01-01' AND doc_date<'2026-09-25' AND card_code=? GROUP BY ALL

queries.label: customer_monthly
queries.sql: WITH x AS (SELECT substr(doc_date,1,7) AS month,'OINV' kind,cast(doc_total AS DECIMAL(38,6)) amount FROM (SELECT * FROM telchi.atomic."sales_document" AT (VERSION => 1408)) WHERE source_system='SAP_B1_HANA' AND canceled='N' AND doc_date>='2026-01-01' AND doc_date<'2026-09-25' AND card_code=? UNION ALL SELECT substr(doc_date,1,7),'ORIN',cast(doc_total AS DECIMAL(38,6)) FROM (SELECT * FROM telchi.atomic."credit_memo_document" AT (VERSION => 1408)) WHERE source_system='SAP_B1_HANA' AND canceled='N' AND doc_date>='2026-01-01' AND doc_date<'2026-09-25' AND card_code=?) SELECT month,count(*) FILTER(WHERE kind='OINV') invoices,count(*) FILTER(WHERE kind='ORIN') credits,coalesce(sum(amount) FILTER(WHERE kind='OINV'),0) billed_bs,coalesce(sum(amount) FILTER(WHERE kind='ORIN'),0) credit_bs,coalesce(sum(amount) FILTER(WHERE kind='OINV'),0)-coalesce(sum(amount) FILTER(WHERE kind='ORIN'),0) net_document_bs FROM x GROUP BY month ORDER BY month

queries.label: invoice_salespersons
queries.sql: SELECT d.slp_code,s.name,count(*) invoices,max(d.doc_date) last_invoice FROM (SELECT * FROM telchi.atomic."sales_document" AT (VERSION => 1408)) d LEFT JOIN read_parquet('/media/issajar/DEVELOP/Projects/iMotorSoft/ai/lab/dataclient/telchi/reference/_versions/v2_reference_closure_2088d5885204313a/salespersons/part-00000.parquet') s ON s.source_system='SAP_HANA' AND s.code=d.slp_code WHERE d.source_system='SAP_B1_HANA' AND d.canceled='N' AND d.doc_date>='2026-01-01' AND d.doc_date<'2026-09-25' AND d.card_code=? GROUP BY ALL ORDER BY invoices DESC,d.slp_code

queries.label: customer_products_uncertain_membership
queries.sql: WITH activity AS (SELECT l.item_code,count(DISTINCT d.doc_entry) invoice_documents,count(*) invoice_lines,min(d.doc_date) first_purchase,max(d.doc_date) last_purchase FROM (SELECT * FROM telchi.atomic."sales_line" AT (VERSION => 1408)) l JOIN (SELECT * FROM telchi.atomic."sales_document" AT (VERSION => 1408)) d ON d.source_system=l.source_system AND d.doc_entry=l.doc_entry WHERE d.source_system='SAP_B1_HANA' AND d.canceled='N' AND d.doc_date>='2026-01-01' AND d.doc_date<'2026-09-25' AND d.source_table='OINV' AND l.source_table='INV1' AND d.card_code='C010264' GROUP BY l.item_code) SELECT x.*,coalesce(p.sap_item_name,p.product_name,p.canonical_name) product,p.sales_uom_id catalog_sales_uom_id,p.sap_sell_item,b.product_business_type,b.status business_type_status,b.classification_basis,b.classification_evidence,r.status portfolio_status,r.source portfolio_source,f.code portfolio_family,'UNACCREDITED_TELCHI_LITEL' membership FROM activity x LEFT JOIN read_parquet('/media/issajar/DEVELOP/Projects/iMotorSoft/ai/lab/dataclient/telchi/reference/_versions/v2_reference_closure_2088d5885204313a/products/part-00000.parquet') p ON p.source_system='SAP_HANA' AND p.item_code=x.item_code LEFT JOIN read_parquet('/media/issajar/DEVELOP/Projects/iMotorSoft/ai/lab/dataclient/telchi/crosswalk/_versions/v2_reference_closure_2088d5885204313a/product_business_type/part-00000.parquet') b ON b.canonical_product_id=p.canonical_product_id LEFT JOIN read_parquet('/media/issajar/DEVELOP/Projects/iMotorSoft/ai/lab/dataclient/telchi/crosswalk/_versions/v2_reference_closure_2088d5885204313a/product_portfolio_family/part-00000.parquet') r ON r.canonical_product_id=p.canonical_product_id LEFT JOIN read_parquet('/media/issajar/DEVELOP/Projects/iMotorSoft/ai/lab/dataclient/telchi/reference/_versions/v2_reference_closure_2088d5885204313a/portfolio_family/part-00000.parquet') f USING(portfolio_family_id) ORDER BY x.invoice_documents DESC,x.item_code

queries.label: independent_customer_products
queries.sql: SELECT item_code,count(DISTINCT doc_entry) invoice_documents FROM (SELECT * FROM telchi.atomic."sales_line" AT (VERSION => 1408)) WHERE source_system='SAP_B1_HANA' AND source_table='INV1' AND doc_entry IN (SELECT doc_entry FROM (SELECT * FROM telchi.atomic."sales_document" AT (VERSION => 1408)) WHERE source_system='SAP_B1_HANA' AND canceled='N' AND doc_date>='2026-01-01' AND doc_date<'2026-09-25' AND source_table='OINV' AND card_code=?) GROUP BY item_code ORDER BY invoice_documents DESC,item_code

queries.label: customer_invoice_lines
queries.sql: SELECT d.doc_entry,d.doc_num,d.doc_date,l.line_num,l.item_code,l.quantity,'UNRESOLVED_LINE_UOM' line_uom,d.currency FROM (SELECT * FROM telchi.atomic."sales_line" AT (VERSION => 1408)) l JOIN (SELECT * FROM telchi.atomic."sales_document" AT (VERSION => 1408)) d ON d.source_system=l.source_system AND d.doc_entry=l.doc_entry WHERE d.source_system='SAP_B1_HANA' AND d.canceled='N' AND d.doc_date>='2026-01-01' AND d.doc_date<'2026-09-25' AND d.source_table='OINV' AND l.source_table='INV1' AND d.card_code=? ORDER BY d.doc_date,d.doc_entry,l.line_num

queries.label: customer_credit_products
queries.sql: SELECT l.item_code,count(DISTINCT d.doc_entry) credit_documents,count(*) credit_lines,max(d.doc_date) last_credit FROM (SELECT * FROM telchi.atomic."credit_memo_line" AT (VERSION => 1408)) l JOIN (SELECT * FROM telchi.atomic."credit_memo_document" AT (VERSION => 1408)) d ON d.source_system=l.source_system AND d.doc_entry=l.doc_entry WHERE d.source_system='SAP_B1_HANA' AND d.canceled='N' AND d.doc_date>='2026-01-01' AND d.doc_date<'2026-09-25' AND d.card_code=? GROUP BY l.item_code ORDER BY l.item_code
